notes.note: Ranking backed up last weeks massive score with another one having 39 disposals 6 tackles 10 clearances and 15 contested possessions. With the Giants at home in R24 look for another big one from him.

The highest score of any Crow ever from Rankine. He was simply amazing with 36 disposals 11 clearances 18 contested possessions and an efficiency of 83%. He has been in outstanding form of late and a fantastic trade in.
Rankine cashed in on the matchup with 3 goals and 23 disposals with 7 marks.  Look for him to do this again this week against the Tigers.

Rankine went head to head with Daicos at the centre bounces and ended with 25 touches 6 clearances and 14 contested possessions. A great performance and with the Bombers and Tigers in the next two would be a great pickup .

Rankine avoided any sort of tag and relished with 20 contested possessions from his 30 disposals and he also led the game with 8 clearances. If you need to get someone in this week he is one to look at as Adelaide have a good run.
This is the Rankine that we all expected to see this season and he was fantastic. 31 disposals 8 tackles and 7 clearances for him as he posted a huge score. Just beware of the Jordon tag this week.
Rankine racked up 27 disposals with this his best since his return but he is still dropping in value so you can afford to wait another week on him.

Rankine had a horror night with just 12 disposals at 50%. He did have some knee and ankle concerns after getting stuck under a tackle early but did finish the game out. He never really got going though.
Rankine returned to the team and was good in the first half but did slow after half time with just 14 of his points coming after half time. He will be better for the run and one to pick up soon.
Rankine looks like he could be back for round 15 and if so he will be a popular trade in.

Rankine was on fire early but left the game early in the third term with a calf injury. He is going to be missing for 3 weeks minimum but one of them is the bye. If not for the byes you could possibly hold but he isn't a guarantee to come back after that third week.

Had the tag early but once the game was done in the second he was released and ended with a game high in contested possessions and clearances with 15 and 10. This is the role we knew he would excel in. Best to wait til after R12 though.

Rankine was massive and dominated the game. 10 marks 9 tackles and 33 disposals to go with a goal. He does have a tricky run coming up with tags from Simpkin and Mullin a night game in Tasmania and a bye.
Rankine is certainly looking back to his best. He had 23 disposals and a goal and if not for that R12 bye he would be a great trade in.
This was more like Rankine. 11 contested possessions and 19 disposals with a couple of goals. This is now two good ones in the last three. He is starting to get back to the form we like to see.
1 goal 3 behinds for Rankine from his 20 disposals but it was the 40% efficiency that hurt his score. Just one score over 70 now in the last 4 isn't really what we were hoping for.

This is the Rankine that we were all expecting to see this season. 2 goals 7 tackles with 22 disposals. His BE is at 92 so you can hold off if you need to as his price shouldn't move upwards a significant amount this week without a huge score.
Rankine struggled again but was better than the previous week. 14 disposals and 3 behinds for him. His BE is still very high so we can watch him for another couple of weeks.
Rankine was tagged by Mullin and really didn't look at his best. He had 7 disposals 1 goal but gave away 3 free kicks. His price will plummet with a BE of 207 so don't go near him for a while.
Rankine returned to the team from his suspension and was quiet for the first half but did start to get into the game in the last where he kicked an important goal that boosted his score.
Rankine will miss round one through suspension
